notes.title: CROSSNIQ+ 1.3.0 (Versus Update) Changelog
notes.notes:
[h1]Versus changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added knockouts - if you shorten your opponent's time bar section to zero via attacks, they'll immediately lose the round.
[*]Added Sudden Death - if both players hold down the Sudden Death button, Sudden Death mode will begin, where Speed Bonuses are easier to achieve and permanent damage buffs are applied.
[*]Added Versus Tutorial - A new landing menu has been added to Versus setup, where you can select a new video tutorial for Versus mode.
[/list]

[h1]QoL:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Control responsiveness enhanced.
[/list]

notes.title: CROSSNIQ+ Windows Video Patch Now Available
notes.notes:
After the release of CROSSNIQ+, we've received reports from a small number of Windows users that video backgrounds are not appearing during play in CROSSNIQ+.

This is due to an as-of-yet unidentified compatibility issue, most likely between user video decoding chipsets and Unity's H264 codec implementation - a problem beyond our direct control.

However, after some testing, we've released an optional standalone patch installer for users experiencing these issues which has fixed the problem for all test users.

[url=https://drive.google.com/open?id=1bc99EMuginXYT5bO27WtLeVmyuK5UM6Z]Download the patch installer here.[/url]

Make sure to follow the instructions in the readme file, and please reach out to us if your video issues persist. Also, a reminder that [b]this patch is for Windows users only.[/b]

notes.title: CROSSNIQ+ 1.2.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]QoL:[/h1][list]
[*]secret codes added
[*]drastically improved loading times
[*]pressing back (X key or Button 2 on gamepad) during net leaderboard display now returns to the menu
[*]changed selection flash on color buttons to increase visibility
[*]subselectors can now be disabled entirely from the advanced options menu
[/list]

[h1]Bugfixes:[/h1][list]
[*]updated a few art assets with newer revisions
[*]fixed G/0's Traffic Jam stoplight from briefly appearing when refresh is used
[*]fixed Haze's shadow being over the pause menu when his item is active
[*]fixed being unable to move in certain directions from certain keys in the rankings name entry
[*]fixed lockup upon going back from item select menu in versus mode setup
[*]fixed lockup upon going back from character select menu in versus mode setup
[*]fixed being able to open both the donation menu and gallery menu at same time in the Chillout menu via a frame-perfect bug
[/list]

[h1]Rebalances:[/h1][list]
[*]doubled currency output from 5 per minute played to 10 per minute played
[*]handicap settings in Versus mode now either increase or decrease the window for performing speed bonuses
[*]Missiles in Versus mode now spawn locked tiles in their blast radius
[*]Bombs in Versus mode now spawn a frozen tile when detonated
[/list]
